outcome: Prevalence of PMAD, severe mental illness, and MDP
cohort: Women in South Carolina who gave birth between 1999 and 2017
finding: PMAD and MDP were associated with an increased risk of various adverse pregnancy and infant outcomes, including severe maternal morbidity, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, cesarean section, preterm birth, low birthweight, and hospital readmissions.
mod_finding: PMAD was associated with a higher risk of cesarean section.
